###### Notes

Total Medicaid expenditures do not include administrative costs, accounting adjustments, or the U.S. Territories. Total Medicaid spending including these additional items was $909 billion in FY 2024.

###### Sources

Estimates based on data downloaded from CMS (Form 64), as of September 2025.

###### Definitions

Federal Fiscal Year: Unless otherwise noted, years preceded by "FY" refer to the Federal Fiscal Year, which runs from October 1 through September 30. FY 2024 refers to the period from October 1, 2023 through September 30, 2024.

## Total Medicaid Spending
